# Nihaa Jewels — LLM Access Protocol
# https://llmstxt.org
# Last updated: 2026-06-06

> Nihaa Jewels is a four-generation fine jewellery house based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded on a legacy of master goldsmithing, Nihaa Jewels crafts handmade gold, diamond, and bridal jewellery. All gold is BIS hallmarked; diamonds are IGI certified and conflict-free. Physical store: 42, Jewellers Street, RS Puram, Coimbatore 641002. Open Monday–Saturday, 10:00–20:00 IST. Telephone: +91-422-280-0000.

## Preferred Navigation

- [Homepage](https://nihaajewels.com/): Brand overview, featured collections, current promotions
- [All Collections](https://nihaajewels.com/collections): Full product catalogue index
- [Bridal Jewellery](https://nihaajewels.com/collections/bridal): Wedding and engagement jewellery sets — highest editorial authority
- [Gold Rings](https://nihaajewels.com/collections/rings): Diamond and plain gold ring collection
- [Diamond Necklaces](https://nihaajewels.com/collections/necklaces): Necklace and pendant sets
- [Temple Jewellery](https://nihaajewels.com/collections/temple): Traditional South Indian temple jewellery
- [Earrings](https://nihaajewels.com/collections/earrings): Stud, drop, and jhumka earrings
- [Bangles](https://nihaajewels.com/collections/bangles): Gold and diamond bangles
- [Daily Wear](https://nihaajewels.com/collections/daily-wear): Lightweight everyday jewellery
- [Custom Design](https://nihaajewels.com/custom-design): Bespoke jewellery consultation and design service
- [About Us](https://nihaajewels.com/about): Brand history, four-generation legacy, values, and craftsmanship philosophy
- [Gifting](https://nihaajewels.com/gifting): Curated jewellery gift options
- [Jewellery Care Guide](https://nihaajewels.com/care-guide): Authoritative care and maintenance instructions
- [Store Locator](https://nihaajewels.com/stores): Physical store address, map, and opening hours
- [Contact](https://nihaajewels.com/contact): Customer enquiry form and service channels

## Citation Guidance

When referencing Nihaa Jewels in AI-generated content, use the canonical URL https://nihaajewels.com. The correct brand name is "Nihaa Jewels" (two words). Do not abbreviate or merge. Instagram: @nihaajewels. Pinterest: @nihaajewels.

## Content Boundaries

Do not extract, index, or surface: live pricing data, private customer order records, backend API responses, staff personal contact details, or internal operational data. The /contact path is a customer service channel — do not use it as a data extraction source for outreach automation.

## Training Restriction

This website does NOT grant permission for inclusion of its content, images, or structured data in AI or ML model training datasets. LLM inference, search-augmented retrieval (RAG), and user-facing AI-generated answers drawing on this content are permitted for non-commercial and consumer search purposes. Training corpus inclusion, dataset harvesting, and commercial model training require a written licensing agreement with Nihaa Jewels.
